title: Commerce, assistant and provider runtime not mounted
security_severity: not rated as a standalone vulnerability
severity_rationale: Users cannot reach the built shopping/approval/payment/provider domain via the canonical gateway.
affected_journeys: See USER_FLOWS.md for shared journey IDs
preconditions: Use the canonical main application/runtime composition; no test-only injection
expected_behavior: Users cannot reach the built shopping/approval/payment/provider domain via the canonical gateway.
observed_behavior: Gateway does not import/mount commerce, assistant or provider factories. Searches find create_commerce_app and build_providers runtime composition only in tests. Strict commerce registry contains no merchant.
user_business_impact: Users cannot reach the built shopping/approval/payment/provider domain via the canonical gateway.
reproduction_validation: Static read plus repository-wide symbol/config-reference search; no repository code executed by this sub-audit
recommended_fix: Create explicit service entrypoint, select persistent store/audit/queue, mount principal-bound gateway routes and raw-body webhook route before JSON parsing, complete missing contract extensions; preserve existing domain checks.
proposed_owner_skill: Backend/platform integration with domain owner review
effort_range: 5–10 engineering days for safe demo integration; real merchant readiness separate
effort_assumptions: Engineering estimate, excluding partner access, deployed-data migration and security review
acceptance_test: Isolated synthetic member → delegation/cart → fresh quote → trusted approval → simulated order → duplicate webhook → one persisted order. Restart service and reconcile without duplicate purchase; strict unavailable merchant must fail honestly.

title: Event effects and timed consumer work have no deployment wiring
security_severity: not rated as a standalone vulnerability
severity_rationale: Social decisions, earned rewards, benefit expiry and order-to-wardrobe updates must complete after the HTTP request.
affected_journeys: See USER_FLOWS.md for shared journey IDs
preconditions: Use the canonical main application/runtime composition; no test-only injection
expected_behavior: Social decisions, earned rewards, benefit expiry and order-to-wardrobe updates must complete after the HTTP request.
observed_behavior: jobs.py and ingress.py have CLI main functions, but configuration search finds no compose/Helm/CI process invoking them. Outbox publisher is a distinct process and broker delivery is not the business effect. The pnpm dev launcher starts only brain, gateway and frontend at scripts/brandme.mjs:184-186, omitting even the consumer HTTP service; docker-compose does include the consumer service after separate key generation.
user_business_impact: Social decisions, earned rewards, benefit expiry and order-to-wardrobe updates must complete after the HTTP request.
reproduction_validation: Static read plus repository-wide symbol/config-reference search; no repository code executed by this sub-audit
recommended_fix: Add supervised jobs and authenticated least-privilege Pub/Sub consumer workloads, subscription/DLQ configuration, bounded retries, health/lag alerts and mode guards; supply fulfillment adapter only where actually available.
proposed_owner_skill: Backend/platform integration with domain owner review
effort_assumptions: Engineering estimate, excluding partner access, deployed-data migration and security review
acceptance_test: Create due decision, close without another user action, consume event twice and award once; restart/pull after failure; expire reservation and release once; confirm observed delivered order appears in wardrobe once.

title: Public privacy capability is selected-rights only; complete account erasure is disconnected
security_severity: not rated as a standalone vulnerability
severity_rationale: Members need an accurate account-wide view/export/deletion across their fashion identity and derived data.
affected_journeys: See USER_FLOWS.md for shared journey IDs
preconditions: Use the canonical main application/runtime composition; no test-only injection
expected_behavior: Members need an accurate account-wide view/export/deletion across their fashion identity and derived data.
observed_behavior: ReadService registry contains rights handler only; selected export fixed to five rights categories; privacy mutation routes return 503. Consumer handlers exist but have no runtime registry composition caller outside tests. Responses are honestly limited; this is an unmet product capability, not a claim of deceptive export.
user_business_impact: Members need an accurate account-wide view/export/deletion across their fashion identity and derived data.
reproduction_validation: Static read plus repository-wide symbol/config-reference search; no repository code executed by this sub-audit
recommended_fix: Review #70 privacy composition, then compose all native handlers plus media purge/providers and replay-safe deletion worker. Extend durable export only after bounded projection and privacy checks. Preserve explicit partial-coverage UI until accepted.
proposed_owner_skill: Backend/platform integration with domain owner review
effort_assumptions: Engineering estimate, excluding partner access, deployed-data migration and security review
acceptance_test: Create data in every domain, reauthenticate, export exact scope, request deletion, process all steps, restart/retry and restore tombstones; verify zero unexpected member rows or derived files while documented lawful/chain exceptions remain explicit.

title: Spatial wardrobe UI has only a guest device repository
security_severity: not rated as a standalone vulnerability
severity_rationale: A member needs authenticated wardrobe persistence across refresh, account changes and devices.
affected_journeys: See USER_FLOWS.md for shared journey IDs
preconditions: Use the canonical main application/runtime composition; no test-only injection
expected_behavior: A member needs authenticated wardrobe persistence across refresh, account changes and devices.
observed_behavior: The only ClosetRepository implementation found is createGuestClosetRepository backed by IndexedDB. useCloset defaults to it; SpatialModeGate intentionally blocks sandbox/production with connection-not-ready copy. The durable server wardrobe exists but is not supplied to this UI.
user_business_impact: A member needs authenticated wardrobe persistence across refresh, account changes and devices.
reproduction_validation: Static read plus repository-wide symbol/config-reference search; no repository code executed by this sub-audit
recommended_fix: Implement an authenticated repository using the existing gateway wardrobe/layout/outfit contracts, account-scoped cache and version/conflict semantics; retain the guest adapter as explicitly separate mode. Remove the strict-mode gate only after complete persistence/authorization evidence.
proposed_owner_skill: Backend/platform integration with domain owner review
effort_assumptions: Engineering estimate, excluding partner access, deployed-data migration and security review
acceptance_test: Sign in as synthetic A, save/place an item, refresh and open another browser session; see same server item. Switch to B and verify no A data. Exercise conflict, offline rollback, permission denial and guest migration without duplication.

title: Legacy region YAML engine is not invoked by the policy endpoint
security_severity: not rated as a standalone vulnerability
product_importance: medium for legacy capability; not prerequisite to the recommended consumer milestone
severity_rationale: Changing repository region YAML must not be mistaken for changing enforced policy behavior.
affected_journeys: See USER_FLOWS.md for shared journey IDs
preconditions: Use the canonical main application/runtime composition; no test-only injection
expected_behavior: Changing repository region YAML must not be mistaken for changing enforced policy behavior.
observed_behavior: Policy endpoint consults two hardcoded blocked-region literals and the consent graph. Repository-wide reference search finds no caller/import of RegionRulesEngine/region_rules outside that module. Its YAML loader is dormant. The shared guard blocks legacy strict-mode startup, limiting exposure; no live vulnerability is claimed.
user_business_impact: Changing repository region YAML must not be mistaken for changing enforced policy behavior.
reproduction_validation: Static read plus repository-wide symbol/config-reference search; no repository code executed by this sub-audit
recommended_fix: If retaining legacy policy, inject and fail-close the reviewed region policy engine, validate YAML and expose loaded policy version; otherwise archive its documented promise after the new domain policy replacement is proven.
proposed_owner_skill: Backend/platform integration with domain owner review
effort_assumptions: Engineering estimate, excluding partner access, deployed-data migration and security review
acceptance_test: A synthetic allowed/denied/escalation fixture changes endpoint behavior according to reviewed region configuration; malformed/missing required policy refuses startup. Verify no unsupported legal compliance claim.
